0xac9650d8.notice: Batch multiple calls to this contract in a single transaction.
0xac9650d8.dev: Each call is executed via `delegatecall` so it runs in the context of the calling contract. If any call reverts, the entire batch reverts with the same revert data.

params.data: An array of calldata payloads to execute.

natspec.notice: Thin Diamond facet that enables batched calls in a single transaction.
natspec.dev: All logic lives in {MulticallLib}. This contract is stateless and has no initializer. Inherit this in your Diamond facet to enable multicall functionality.
